reviewedBy: Joshua Moss, MD (requesting author), with PR #972 approval
scope: Declares which connected-practice tasks (interview, rounds, note) each chapter is a fitting rehearsal for. Combined with each chapter's objectiveIds this yields an objective-by-task coverage matrix that tests/case-journeys.test.mjs gates and export_curriculum_review.py prints. It changes no learner-visible text and no practice wording; the practice pack itself stays generic. The projection carries each chapter's tasks into the learner JSON as `practiceTasks`; the renderer marks them as suggested on the practice chooser. All three tasks stay available.

rules.everyChapterMapped: each of the 18 chapters lists at least one task
rules.everyObjectiveReachesEveryTask: for each case, every learning objective reaches each task through at least one of its chapters, or the gap is listed under acceptedGaps with a reason
rules.everyTaskAnchored: for each case, each task is declared on at least one chapter

acceptedGaps.reason: Leah-02 is a recognition-and-escalation vignette by faculty design (snapshot teachingPoint); documentation of withdrawal management is not a learner task here.
Marisol-01 places medical urgency before an extended psychiatric interview by design; the interview task would contradict the chapter.
Marisol-03 teaches serial observation and reporting of hypoactive features; the skill is description across time, not interviewing.
